generationName.description:
Human-readable name of the Generation referenced by `generationUuid`.
Resolved server-side: the Generation entity is looked up by `generationUuid`
and its `name` field is propagated here. Falls back to `'Unknown Generation'`
if the generation can't be found (e.g. it was deleted). `undefined` when the
backup has no `generationUuid` at all (legacy backups).

Cluster.description: Describing a Camunda cluster running in your organization. For reference, use the UUID.

autoUpdate.description:
The cluster will automatically be updated by Camunda when a new C8 version is released
If the cluster you want to create is running on a non-stable Channel passing this property will be ignored!

encryption.description:
Encryption configuration for the cluster.

`type` matches what was selected at create-time (Software / Hardware /
Provider / External). `primaryKeyArn` / `secondaryKeyArn` are populated
only for `External` (BYOK) clusters once keys have been configured via
`PUT /clusters/{clusterUuid}/encryption`. `status` is only present when
`type` is `External` and reflects the operator reconciliation state —
poll for `Ready` to confirm BYOK is active.

UpdateClusterEncryptionBody.description:
Used to set or rotate the customer-managed encryption keys on a BYOK
(encryption=External) cluster. Both ARNs must point to AWS KMS keys
located in the cluster's primary and backup regions respectively. For
single-region clusters, omit `secondaryEncryptionKeyId`.

primaryEncryptionKeyId.description:
AWS KMS key ARN for the cluster's primary region. Single-region key
ARNs and multi-region key (`mrk-...`) ARNs are both accepted, as long
as the ARN's region segment matches the cluster's region.

secondaryEncryptionKeyId.description:
AWS KMS key ARN for the cluster's backup region. Required when the
cluster's backup configuration is dual-region; must be omitted for
single-region clusters. Must differ from `primaryEncryptionKeyId`.

put.description:
Configures or rotates the customer-managed encryption keys on a BYOK
(encryption=External) cluster.

Preconditions:
 - the cluster was created with `encryption: 'External'` (otherwise 409)
 - the org is on the Enterprise plan and the cluster region is AWS
   (otherwise 403)
 - both ARNs must be well-formed AWS KMS key ARNs with region segments
   matching the cluster's primary / backup region (otherwise 400)
 - `secondaryEncryptionKeyId` is required for dual-region clusters and
   must be omitted for single-region clusters (otherwise 400)

200.description: Ok

400.description: Invalid ARN, region mismatch, or dual-region requirement violated

403.description: External encryption not available for this org/region

409.description: Cluster is not configured for external encryption

This endpoint only exposes egress IP addresses for the related services.
Expected changes will be published through the API at least 24 hours in advance.
